title: Find Subarrays With Equal Sum
summary: Given an array of integers, check if there are two distinct starting points where the sum of the first two elements is the same.
statement: Given an array of integers, check if there are two distinct starting points where the sum of the first two elements is the same. Return true if such subarrays exist, otherwise return false.
constraints: Consider every contiguous subarray of length two.
Return true when two different adjacent pairs have equal sums.
reference_solution:
def has_equal_adjacent_pair_sums(nums):
    seen=set()
    for index in range(len(nums)-1):
        total=nums[index]+nums[index+1]
        if total in seen:return True
        seen.add(total)
    return False

def has_equal_adjacent_pair_sums(nums):
    seen=set()
    for index in range(len(nums)-2):
        total=nums[index]+nums[index+1]
        if total in seen:return True
        seen.add(total)
    return False
hints: Compute each adjacent pair sum from left to right.
Store previously seen sums in a set.
Return true on the first repeated sum; otherwise add it and continue.
A set membership hit is equivalent to an earlier distinct adjacent pair having the same sum.
editorial: A set membership hit is equivalent to an earlier distinct adjacent pair having the same sum.

tests.explanation: The pairs [4,2] and [2,4] both sum to six.
The adjacent sums three, five, seven, and nine are all distinct.
